item.title: Before I Trust an Agent, I Try to Break Its Box
item.description:
Updated 15 November 2026 for 0.1.0-rc.3The attack results below were recorded in October 2026 on Koala’s preview builds. This update adds the eight-hour runs and domain grants from rc.3, and marks the bugs fixed since.

An AI agent is not a predictable app. It reads web pages, messages, and files, and it may act on instructions hidden in any of them. The safer assumption is that, sooner or later, something untrusted will run wherever the agent runs.
